issue_or_check: Column labels may contain inconsistent capitalization or spacing
rationale: Consistent names reduce coding errors and make the pipeline reusable.

issue_or_check: Missing or blank review titles and bodies
action_taken: Filled missing title with empty string; replaced absent image values with 'No image uploaded'; retained missing review body for audit and excluded it from NLP subset
rationale: A missing title does not make an otherwise complete review unusable. The image label makes absent uploads explicit instead of displaying NaN. Missing review text cannot support text analysis.

issue_or_check: 13 exact duplicate rows found; no stable review_id field is available
action_taken: Removed 0 duplicate review IDs and 13 exact duplicate rows
rationale: Exact duplicate rows can overweight repeated feedback. user_id identifies a reviewer and is not a unique review key.

issue_or_check: Ratings may be missing, non-numeric, or outside the 1–5 scale
action_taken: Converted ratings to numeric and flagged missing/out-of-range values
rationale: Rating-based analysis requires valid values; invalid ratings are excluded only from rating-dependent analysis.

issue_or_check: Timestamp representation may be text or epoch milliseconds
action_taken: Parsed into UTC datetime and flagged unparseable values
rationale: A consistent datetime type supports time-based analysis and reproducible filtering.

issue_or_check: HTML fragments, irregular whitespace, and blank review text
action_taken: Removed HTML tags, normalized whitespace, created cleaned title/body and combined text
rationale: Conservative normalization improves consistency without deleting potentially meaningful sentiment cues.

issue_or_check: Review word-count IQR fences: lower=0.00, upper=165.00
action_taken: Flagged 728 length outliers; retained them in the master dataset
rationale: IQR is a screening method. Long reviews may be informative and should not be removed without content review.

action_taken: Inspected distinct values and flagged constant columns for interpretation
rationale: Constant fields may have limited analytical value but can still be valid metadata; retain until the project question is finalized.

issue_or_check: Different analyses require different minimum fields
action_taken: Created NLP-ready and valid-rating subsets without deleting records from the master dataset
rationale: This avoids unnecessary data loss and makes the inclusion criteria explicit.
